annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses identify the same core operational risk: repeated stock discrepancies may indicate inventory records drifting from physical stock, creating downstream picking/service problems. Each considers recurrence/patterns and the likelihood of escalation or broader impact. Each also proposes a proportionate response involving additional checks/cycle counts, investigating root cause, and escalating if the issue appears systemic. Response A is more conversational and mentions contingency planning, B adds supervisor notification and a temporary hold on stock adjustments, and C is more concise, but these are refinements rather than materially different commitments under the stated criteria.
